# Track C: trailing buys without a required initial dip (generated by `npm run d1-refinement -- no-dip`)

All runs from 2017-06-15 (the common eligibility session), $100,000 per entry, 11% interest, stop fills, D1's accounting and exit set (trailing stop active only while a fill at the stop nets a profit; maximum-hold loss exit; buffered intraday loss 2.9%). D1 for comparison: $183,044 / $19,331, 20 entries, exposure 36%.

## 2. Bounded local refinement and walk-forward

Anchors are the best feasible grid cell of each design (an in-sample choice) and, for C1, the literal design. The box covers the mechanism's own parameters and the exit set; X and L do not exist in these architectures.

### C1 anchored at the best grid cell (stop 6.0% hold 8 buffer 2.9% Ya 1.0%)

Family `always`; anchor stop 6.0% hold 8 buffer 2.9% Ya 1.0%; box Ya 0.5%–15.0%, stop 4.0%–12.0%, hold 4–40, buffer 0.0%–5.0%; 2049 unique points from 2048 Sobol draws (seed label 'trackC-c1_best'); 126 feasible on the full run; 2049 distinct trade lists.

Full-run net over the design: min −$49,144, 10% $8,219, median $55,655, 90% $99,365, max $142,869. Anchor $126,378 / $34,878; D1 $183,044 / $19,331. Within the ceiling, 0 points (0%) beat the anchor's net, 0 (0%) beat D1's, and 0 (0%) beat D1 on both net and drawdown.

#### Full-run picks (in-sample) and their coordinate refinement

Policies: maxNet = highest net among feasible candidates (minute DD ≤ $35,000); balanced = highest net with minute DD ≤ $20,000 (D1's drawdown band), else maxNet; lowDd = lowest minute DD among candidates with net ≥ 80% of maxNet's; frequent = highest net among candidates with at least 1.5 × the reference entry count, else none. Refinement moves one parameter at a time to its best grid value inside the box until nothing improves the policy's objective.

#### Full-run picks (in-sample) and their coordinate refinement

Policies: maxNet = highest net among feasible candidates (minute DD ≤ $35,000); balanced = highest net with minute DD ≤ $20,000 (D1's drawdown band), else maxNet; lowDd = lowest minute DD among candidates with net ≥ 80% of maxNet's; frequent = highest net among candidates with at least 1.5 × the reference entry count, else none. Refinement moves one parameter at a time to its best grid value inside the box until nothing improves the policy's objective.

## 3. C3: D1 plus an independent no-dip path

D1's eight parameters frozen; the extra path (always or swing) arms only when D1 would not, yields to D1's deep and continuation armings on the minute they occur, and never closes the continuation window. It can displace a D1 trade only by holding the position when D1 would have armed. Trades are compared with D1: preserved (same entry and exit), altered (same entry, different exit: impossible here, since exits don't depend on the path), gained (extra-path entries) and lost (D1 entries displaced).
